description: The Places API enables powerful location search and geocoding capabilities for your applications, offering global coverage with rich, detailed information.

subcommands.name: autocomplete
subcommands.description: The autocomplete operation speeds up and increases the accuracy of entering addresses by providing a list of address candidates matching a partially entered add…

options.name: --query-text
options.description: The free-form text query to match addresses against. This is usually a partially typed address from an end user in an address box or form

options.name: --max-results
options.description: An optional limit for the number of results returned in a single call

options.name: --bias-position
options.description: The position in longitude and latitude that the results should be close to.

options.name: --filter
options.description: A structure which contains a set of inclusion/exclusion properties that results must posses in order to be returned as a result

options.name: --postal-code-mode
options.description: The PostalCodeMode affects how postal code results are returned.

options.name: --additional-features
